root_cause: The workshop collateral and the scan result PDF were treated as one generic report family.
That blurred the user journey: one page belongs before the scan, while two pages belong only after completion.
prevention: Maintain exactly three visual surfaces for the workshop journey: one pre-scan handout plus two post-scan result pages.
Never include the workshop handout inside the participant's generated result PDF.
Page one after completion is benchmark/strength/friction/domain detail.
Page two after completion is top-three levers/90-day roadmap/KPIs/portal continuation.
Only show measured or derivable KPI values; do not fabricate improvement percentages from questionnaire answers.
